name: Electric Solenoid 24 VDC – For 35 To 560 LB Cylinders
legacyName: Electric Solenoid 24 VDC- For 35 To 560 LB Cylinders- UL Listed

subcategory.name: Clean Agent Fire Extinguishing System Cylinders & Accessories

summary: The electric solenoid is used to discharge the cylinder valve. The cylinder valve is a normally closed valve that requires electrical energy to open. The electric solenoid is used to vent the pressure from the top of the piston in the cylinder valve, allowing the piston to slide upward and commence cylinder discharge.
description: The electric solenoid part number CP50025-2 is suitable for use with the Context Plus Extinguishant Cylinders with capacity of 35LB to 560LB. This solenoid is not suitable for the 1200LB Extinguishant Cylinder.
